post.description:
Needs an active assignment and an active service at the location, and the clinic open now or
within your shift window, which starts up to 60 minutes before the shift (422 with a `reason_code` such as
`no_assignment`, `outside_hours` otherwise). Already IN here: 200 with the current state. Open session in
another state or at another location: 409 `open_session`.

422.description: VALIDATION_FAILED. For a check-in the rules refused, reason_code is one of: doctor_not_active, location_not_active, no_assignment, no_service_mode, clinic_closed, closed_holiday, outside_hours; otherwise errors lists the invalid fields.

409.description: INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, reason_code `open_session`: the doctor already has an open session in another state or at another location (errors.clinic_location_id only for the doctor and staff of that location), or `change_in_progress` (CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION): retry.

post.description:
Calls the head of the queue order (triage, then the time they became ready, then the number); REGISTERED entries are never called. Needs
`walkins.call_patient`. `409` codes: DOCTOR_NOT_AVAILABLE (reason_code on_break, unavailable, not_checked_in, checked_out, doctor_not_active, location_not_active, no_assignment, no_doctor),
QUEUE_CLOSED (reason_code closed or not_today), ENTRY_ALREADY_CALLED (errors.entry_id), DOCTOR_ALREADY_CALLING (reason_code other_queue or previous_day; no ids), QUEUE_EMPTY, APPOINTMENT_WINDOW_PROTECTED (reason_code appointment or hold,
errors.blocked_until), CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION (retry with a new key). Never overrides a protected window, and `override_reason_code` in the body is refused (422).
post.summary: Call the next patient

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A new UUID or ULID for each distinct request; the same one when retrying it.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: no such record, or the caller has no standing at it (its existence is not revealed).

409.description: DOCTOR_NOT_AVAILABLE (reason_code: on_break, unavailable, not_checked_in, checked_out, doctor_not_active, location_not_active, no_assignment, no_doctor: the queue has no doctor), QUEUE_CLOSED (reason_code: closed, not_today), ENTRY_ALREADY_CALLED (errors.entry_id), DOCTOR_ALREADY_CALLING (reason_code: other_queue, previous_day; no ids), QUEUE_EMPTY, APPOINTMENT_WINDOW_PROTECTED (reason_code: appointment or hold; errors.blocked_until), or CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION (retry with a NEW key). Call-next never overrides a protected window. Any 4xx answer is replayed for 48 hours for the same key, so send a NEW Idempotency-Key for each attempt.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: the Idempotency-Key header (a UUID or ULID) is missing. Reuse a key only to retry the same request; any 4xx answer is replayed for 48 hours.

post.description:
The entry must be WAITING and the head of the queue order (409 NOT_NEXT_IN_ORDER otherwise). `409` codes: DOCTOR_NOT_AVAILABLE (reason_code on_break,
unavailable, not_checked_in, checked_out, doctor_not_active, location_not_active, no_assignment, no_doctor), QUEUE_CLOSED (reason_code closed or not_today),
ENTRY_ALREADY_CALLED (errors.entry_id), DOCTOR_ALREADY_CALLING (reason_code other_queue or previous_day;
no ids), APPOINTMENT_WINDOW_PROTECTED (reason_code appointment or hold), CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION (retry with a new key).
`override_reason_code` lets a triaged patient pass an appointment-window refusal and needs `walkins.manage_queue` (422 for a patient with no triage).

post.description:
Needs an `Idempotency-Key` (a retry with the same key and body returns the same entry). Send `patient_profile_id` for yourself or a
dependant you manage (patient path), or `guest` for a person the clinic registers at the desk (staff or doctor path). The server decides
the channel, the queue, the number and the fee. Patient-app registration is off until the clinic turns it on, needs your verified mobile
number and the doctor to be checked in, and is limited per day. `409` codes: QUEUE_NOT_STARTED, REGISTRATION_NOT_ALLOWED (reason_code),
QUEUE_CLOSED (reason_code), QUEUE_FULL, CAPACITY_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED, ENTRY_ALREADY_LIVE (errors.entry_id), DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED (reason_code),
LATE_RISK_ACK_REQUIRED, CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION (retry). The estimate is a range or nothing, never a promise.

Reuse the Idempotency-Key only for a retry of the same body: any other 4xx is replayed for 48 hours.

BroadcastAuthRequest.description:
The Pusher-protocol subscription handshake. Only `presence-` channels are authorized: every
channel we publish on is a presence channel so Reverb can tie the connection to a user and
terminate it (increment 5.4b, M-3). The `private-` spelling (and private-encrypted-) is refused
with 422, because signing it would let a subscriber join without a user id. Whether this user
may join the named channel is decided by the channel callback in routes/channels.php.

Patterns end in `\z`, not `$`: `$` also matches before a trailing newline, which the Pusher
library then rejects with a 500.

socket_id.description: The connection id the WebSocket server gave the client, like `1234.5678`.

channel_name.description: The channel to join, with its prefix, like `presence-user.{id}`.

BroadcastAuthRequest.title: BroadcastAuthRequest

override_reason_code.description: Never accepted: call-next cannot override a protected appointment window (use `/walk-ins/{id}/call`).

anyOf.description:
Only to call a triaged patient (priority or urgent) whose call would overlap a protected appointment window or an active hold.
A fixed code, no free text. Needs `walkins.manage_queue`; the override is audited. Call-next never accepts it.

CancelReason.description: Why an entry was cancelled (decision 52). Only the code is ever stored on the event, audit row or notice.
CancelReason.title: CancelReason

reason_code.description: PATIENT_REQUEST, PATIENT_LEFT, DUPLICATE_ENTRY or OTHER. A fixed code: no free text.

patient_informed_in_person.description: Staff cancelling a guest's entry must confirm they told the patient in person.

CapacityMode.description:
How a doctor's walk-in queue capacity at a location is decided (B9): from the schedule, or no cap with the cutoff only. | | |---| | `DERIVED`
Capacity comes from the schedule (walkin_capacity, else window minutes over slot length). | | `UNLIMITED`
No cap: only the cutoff stops registrations. Stored on the queue as a null capacity. |
CapacityMode.title: CapacityMode

anyOf.description: Required for PRIORITY and URGENT: a fixed code, no free text.

priority_note.description: An optional short note for a priority: no symptoms or diagnosis. At most 140 characters. Kept encrypted on the entry; never in events, audit rows or notices.

doctor_id.description: Clinic staff only: the doctor to act for. Omit to change your own presence.

clinic_location_id.description: The clinic location to check in at (required: online presence is not available). Unknown fields such as location evidence are ignored.

anyOf.description: Why, as a fixed code (SHIFT_START, LATE_ARRIVAL, COVERING_COLLEAGUE, ADMIN_WORK, PHONE_CALL, EMERGENCY, PERSONAL, OTHER). No free text.

fee.description: Fee in centavos, its currency and a display string such as "₱650.00".

is_hmo_eligible.description: Whether the doctor accepts HMOs for this service; coverage is never assumed (§12.10).

EndAssignmentRequest.description: End (or withdraw) an assignment: a short reason is kept with it.
EndAssignmentRequest.title: EndAssignmentRequest

message.description: Safe to show; never personal or clinical data.

errors.description: Field name to a list of messages, or a state hint such as {"status": ["IN"]}.

reason_code.description: Optional finer reason inside the code, for example `no_assignment` or `open_session`. Absent when the code says it all.

state.description: NOT_STARTED (the doctor has not checked in), OPEN, PAUSED or CLOSED. Drives the Join button (E8).

state_reason_code.description: Why the state is PAUSED or CLOSED; null when OPEN or NOT_STARTED.

accepts_remote_registration.description: Whether the app can register this patient now.

remote_refusal_reason_code.description: Why not: doctor_not_active, location_not_active, remote_registration_off, mobile_not_verified, queue_not_started, doctor_unavailable, doctor_checked_out, paused, closed, cutoff_passed, clinic_closed_today or no_walkin_hours_today.

fee.description: The listed fee in minor units. Nothing is charged here.

estimate.description: Present only when the app can register you now. No place in line: that would count the queue.

requires_late_risk_acknowledgement.description: True when the range reaches closing time: joining then needs `acknowledge_late_risk` (E1).

doctor_id.description: Clinic staff only: the doctor to act for. Omit to change your own presence.

clinic_location_id.description: Required when acting for another doctor: the location where you hold presence rights.

anyOf.description: Why, as a fixed code (SHIFT_START, LATE_ARRIVAL, COVERING_COLLEAGUE, ADMIN_WORK, PHONE_CALL, EMERGENCY, PERSONAL, OTHER). No free text. Kept for the clinic's records; never shown to patients.

verification_status.description: D-40: confirmed by a reviewer, or as stated by the doctor

specialty_review_pending.description: D-40: a verified doctor has specialty changes a reviewer has not confirmed yet.

OnboardingStatus.description: Doctor onboarding (CLAUDE.md §5.2). Only ACTIVE doctors can be booked or listed.
OnboardingStatus.title: OnboardingStatus

PayerType.description: Who the patient says will pay. HMO here is a claim, never a verified coverage (principle 12): until Phase 7A the entry holds only the card name as typed.
PayerType.title: PayerType

PresenceActionRequest.description:
Base for presence writes. Fine-grained authorization (own presence, or presence.manage at the
location) is decided by PresenceAccess in the controller; this is only the coarse gate.

doctor_id.description: Clinic staff only: the doctor to act for. Omit to change your own presence.

clinic_location_id.description: Required when acting for another doctor: the location where you hold presence rights.

PresenceActionRequest.title: PresenceActionRequest

PresenceReason.description: Why a presence change was made: a fixed code, never free text (free text can carry personal or clinical detail and ends up in event rows and logs). Shown to the clinic's staff only; never public.
PresenceReason.title: PresenceReason

status.description: The stored status: IN, ON_BREAK or TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE while a session is open, otherwise NOT_CHECKED_IN.

session_id.description: Null when there is no open session.

break_expected_end_at.description: UTC; set only while ON_BREAK. An expectation, not a promise.

version.description: Increases with every change; clients can ignore an older hint.

PriorityReason.description: Why an entry has a triage level above normal (decisions 88 to 91). Only the code is ever stored on events, audit rows and broadcasts; the free-text note is encrypted on the entry and goes nowhere else.
PriorityReason.title: PriorityReason

licence_verified.description: The PRC licence was checked by a MediConnect reviewer.
The PRC licence was checked by a MediConnect reviewer.

status.description: IN, BUSY, ON_BREAK, AWAY or NOT_IN. Indicative: it is set by the doctor or clinic staff and can lag.

clinic_location_id.description: Where the doctor is checked in; null when NOT_IN.

restricted.description: True when any queue is shown in the restricted view (no names, phones, HMO text or notes).

capacity.description: Null means no cap (only the cutoff stops registrations).

date_of_birth.description: D-37: account holders must be adults (minors are dependents).

accept_privacy_notice_version.description: The client must show and send the versions it displayed; stale apps are refused.

doctor_service_id.description: The in-person doctor service the patient registers for. The server derives the doctor, location and queue from it.

patient_profile_id.description: The patient path: your own patient profile, or a dependant you are authorized to manage. Exclusive with `guest`.

guest.description: The staff or doctor path: a guest the clinic registers at the desk. Exclusive with `patient_profile_id`.

phone.description: The guest's contact number, optional (a Philippine mobile number).

hmo_card_name_text.description: What the patient says their HMO is called, as printed on the card. Required for HMO, refused for SELF_PAY. Never verified.

priority_level.description: Staff and doctor only. NORMAL (default), PRIORITY or URGENT.

anyOf.description: Required for PRIORITY and URGENT. Staff and doctor only.

priority_note.description: An optional short note for a priority: no symptoms or diagnosis. At most 140 characters. Staff and doctor only.

privacy_notice_version.description: The version of the privacy notice that was shown to the guest: one of the published versions. Required with `guest`.

capacity_override.description: Staff and doctor only: add the guest although the queue is over its planned capacity. Audited.

acknowledge_late_risk.description: Patient path: confirm that the clinic may not be able to see you today (the server asks when the range reaches closing time).

RegisterWalkInRequest.title: RegisterWalkInRequest

RejectDoctorRequest.description: POST /admin/doctors/{id}/reject: the reason is shown to the doctor so they can fix it.

more_documents.description: True asks for more documents rather than rejecting outright; the doctor may resubmit either way.

RejectDoctorRequest.title: RejectDoctorRequest

RequestContactChangeCodeRequest.description: POST /auth/contact/otp: the new email or mobile, and the current password.
RequestContactChangeCodeRequest.title: RequestContactChangeCodeRequest

note.description: Shown to the doctor; required when rejecting.

Role.description: Platform roles (CLAUDE.md §20.1). Roles are global labels; which clinics a clinic role applies to is held in clinic_members (D-17), not in Spatie teams.
Role.title: Role

ScheduleRequest.description:
Create (POST) or change (PATCH) a weekly schedule with its shifts and breaks
in one payload. On PATCH every field is optional, `shifts` replaces all
shifts, and the version comes from `If-Match` (or `version`).
ScheduleRequest.title: ScheduleRequest

version.description: Send back as If-Match when changing the schedule.

SearchWalkInsRequest.description: GET /walk-ins/search: the staff dedupe search over one location's live entries today.

term.description: A queue number (`A-07`, `7`), an exact phone number, or part of a name (at least 2 characters). Never logged or audited.

SearchWalkInsRequest.title: SearchWalkInsRequest

ServiceMode.description: How patients reach a doctor for one service at one location (§7.1).
ServiceMode.title: ServiceMode

service_mode.description: APPOINTMENT, WALK_IN or BOTH; null when not set yet. Online services are APPOINTMENT only.

Sex.description: Sex where clinically required (§4.3). Values follow the HL7 administrative gender set. Optional everywhere it is collected.
Sex.title: Sex

specialty_id.description: the parent specialty, for filtering doctor search

doctor_count.description: ACTIVE doctors with this confirmed specialty

doctor_id.description: Clinic staff only: the doctor to act for. Omit to change your own presence.

clinic_location_id.description: Required when acting for another doctor: the location where you hold presence rights.

expected_minutes.description: How long the break is expected to last, in minutes (at most the configured maximum, 240 by default).

scheduled_break_id.description: One of the doctor's scheduled breaks at this location, when the break is a scheduled one.

StartDoctorOnboardingRequest.description: POST /doctors: start onboarding as a doctor (D-16: the patient profile stays).

display_name.description: The name patients see, for example "Dr. Ana Santos".

confirm_licensed.description: The applicant states they are a physician licensed by the PRC; verification follows.

StartDoctorOnboardingRequest.title: StartDoctorOnboardingRequest

guardian_attestation.description: The guardian confirms they are authorised to manage this person's health information.

guardian_attestation_version.description: The attestation version the app displayed; stale apps are refused.

SuspendUserRequest.description: Suspend or reactivate: sensitive, so a reason is required (rbac-permissions.md §7).
SuspendUserRequest.title: SuspendUserRequest

UpdateClinicRequest.description: PATCH /clinics/{id}: only the fields sent change.
UpdateClinicRequest.title: UpdateClinicRequest

UpdateClinicServiceRequest.description: PATCH /clinics/{id}/locations/{locationId}/services/{serviceId}: only the fields sent change.
UpdateClinicServiceRequest.title: UpdateClinicServiceRequest

UpdateDependentRequest.description: PATCH /patients/me/dependents/{id}: only the fields sent change.
UpdateDependentRequest.title: UpdateDependentRequest

UpdateDoctorServiceRequest.description: PATCH /doctors/me/services/{id}: a change ends this row and starts a replacement.
UpdateDoctorServiceRequest.title: UpdateDoctorServiceRequest

UpdateLocationRequest.description: PATCH /clinics/{id}/locations/{locationId}: only the fields sent change.

latitude.description: No `sometimes`: sending one coordinate without the other must fail validation.

UpdateLocationRequest.title: UpdateLocationRequest

UpdateMyDoctorProfileRequest.description:
PATCH /doctors/me. Scalar fields change only when sent; the lists
(languages, specialties, education, experience) replace the whole set.

prc_license_number.description: Digits only. Locked while under review and after verification.

languages.description: ISO 639 codes, for example en, fil, ceb.

UpdateMyDoctorProfileRequest.title: UpdateMyDoctorProfileRequest

UpdateMyPatientProfileRequest.description: PATCH /patients/me: only the fields sent are changed.
UpdateMyPatientProfileRequest.title: UpdateMyPatientProfileRequest

UpdateSettingRequest.description: PUT /admin/settings/{key}: any JSON value except null, and a reason.
UpdateSettingRequest.title: UpdateSettingRequest

UpdateSpecialtyRequest.description: PATCH /admin/specialties/{id}: only the fields sent change.

reviewed.description: A MEDICAL_ADMIN marks the entry as reviewed (D-39).

UpdateSpecialtyRequest.title: UpdateSpecialtyRequest

UpdateSubspecialtyRequest.description: PATCH /admin/subspecialties/{id}: only the fields sent change.
UpdateSubspecialtyRequest.title: UpdateSubspecialtyRequest

UpdateSynonymRequest.description: PATCH /admin/search/synonyms/{id}: only the fields sent change.
UpdateSynonymRequest.title: UpdateSynonymRequest

UpdateUserRolesRequest.description: PUT /admin/users/{id}/roles: the complete set of roles the user should hold, and why.
UpdateUserRolesRequest.title: UpdateUserRolesRequest

UpdateWalkInPolicyRequest.description: PATCH /clinics/{clinicId}/doctor-assignments/{assignmentId}/walkin-policy: only the keys sent change. Unknown keys are refused.

allow_patient_app_registration.description: Whether patients may join this doctor's walk-in queue from the app. Off by default; the patient also needs a verified mobile number.

cutoff_minutes_before_close.description: Minutes before closing (or the last walk-in window's end) after which nobody new is admitted. 0 to 240, default 30.

number_prefix.description: The queue-number prefix for this doctor's queues at the location, 1 to 4 capital letters; a free letter is used when it is taken or null.

capacity_mode.description:
DERIVED takes the capacity from the schedule; UNLIMITED admits until the cutoff. | | |---| | `DERIVED`
Capacity comes from the schedule (walkin_capacity, else window minutes over slot length). | | `UNLIMITED`
No cap: only the cutoff stops registrations. Stored on the queue as a null capacity. |

recall_limit.description: How many times a called patient may be recalled before staff may mark them a no-show. 1 to 10 (WalkInPolicy::MAX_RECALL_LIMIT), default 2.

UpdateWalkInPolicyRequest.title: UpdateWalkInPolicyRequest

file.description: PDF, JPEG or PNG, checked by content as well as extension.

expires_on.description: Expiry printed on the document, if any (for example a PRC ID).

label.description: The number the patient is told, for example `A-07`: a place in this queue, not an appointment.

status.description: REGISTERED (joined from the app, not arrived), WAITING, CALLED, IN_CONSULTATION, COMPLETED, SKIPPED, NO_SHOW, CANCELLED.

local_date.description: The queue's local date at the location (Y-m-d).

fee.description: The listed consultation fee in minor units. Nothing is charged: the fee is paid at the clinic and the final charge is the clinic's to set.

name.description: The patient's or guest's name; null once a guest's data has been purged.

called_at.description: When the entry was called (UTC), null if it never was. A recall does not change it. Staff and doctor only.

recall_count.description: How many times the called patient was called again since the last call. Staff and doctor only.

hmo_claim.description: What the patient says their HMO is called: as typed, not verified. Never a coverage statement.

estimate.description: Staff estimate with the basis codes. Minutes appear for the next waiting entries only.

label.description: The number the patient is told, for example `A-07`: a place in this queue, not an appointment.

status.description: REGISTERED (joined from the app, not arrived), WAITING, CALLED, IN_CONSULTATION, COMPLETED, SKIPPED, NO_SHOW, CANCELLED.

local_date.description: The queue's local date at the location (Y-m-d).

fee.description: The listed consultation fee in minor units. Nothing is charged: the fee is paid at the clinic and the final charge is the clinic's to set.

priority_level.description: Restricted readers see place and status only: no name, phone, HMO text or note.

label.description: The number the patient is told, for example `A-07`: a place in this queue, not an appointment.

status.description: REGISTERED (joined from the app, not arrived), WAITING, CALLED, IN_CONSULTATION, COMPLETED, SKIPPED, NO_SHOW, CANCELLED.

local_date.description: The queue's local date at the location (Y-m-d).

fee.description: The listed consultation fee in minor units. Nothing is charged: the fee is paid at the clinic and the final charge is the clinic's to set.

estimate.description: The estimate, or null once the entry is no longer in the queue. Minutes are withheld when they would be a guess about a guess.

recall_limit.description: How many times a called patient may be recalled before staff may mark a no-show.

derived_capacity_today.description: The capacity today's schedule gives this doctor here (the sum over today's walk-in shifts). With UNLIMITED it is informational: the queue has no cap.

local_date.description: The location's local date the capacity is for (Y-m-d).

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
